events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years on, the impact of Elvis Presley is still felt across music and culture. What's your favourite track from The King?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders defined an era. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis legend and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid, Liam Gallagher, is 54 today! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, he's still got that swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since Dr. No premiered, the world's favourite secret agent is still captivating audiences. Who's your definitive Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today would have marked the 86th birthday of The Beatles' legendary co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled artistry and vision of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the incredible Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: A True Champion
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. A true legend who lives on through his music.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965 in the UK.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed their sound in new directions. A true masterpiece. What's your favourite track?
